translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Sudsuhuwon to Kopitan to mgo Sundau
Nopongnga ni Disas tid oseng idda langun diyon to mgo minuvu, mid undiyon sikandin to Capernaum.
Na rutun, duwon sokkad no kopitan to mgo sundau to Roma. Duwon sudsuhuwon din no id dokollan din to ginawa no novohokan woy asow ron od patoy.
To norinog taddot kopitan iddos moka‑atag ki Disas, id popiyod din iddos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio amoy'd nganoy ki Disas no od undiyonnan din woy'd bowiyan iddos sudsuhuwon din.
To kod‑inguma ran, id po‑eru‑eru sikandan ki Disas. Kahi ran to, “Kolimulimu, tovangiyu iddos kopitan su ollog en sikandin nod tovangan,
oyyos dakkoo kos ginawa rin keta no mgo Judio, woy sikandin kos id povovaa to simba‑an doy ka‑ay'n lugaa.”

De‑en id duma si Disas kandan. Piru to morani ron sikandin diyot baoy, id suhu taddot kopitan iddos mgo oukuy rin no od tommuwon dan si Disas woy'd po‑osengan to, “Longaggon, yo kad od luggatluggat nod allus, su konna a ollog nod po‑usok kikow riyot baoy ku.
Konna a ollog ahad kodtommu ra en kikow. Osengow robbo woy od ko‑uliyan en iddos sudsuhuwon ku.

Nokosaddoo a ka‑ay, oyyos ahad siyak, no‑iraom a to kotungud taddot mowwet pa koddi, woy duwon mandad mgo sundau no no‑iraom to koddin kotungud. Otid ikahi a riyot sokkad no, ‘Ipanow kad,’ na od ipanow en sikandin. Woy otid ikahi a riyot sokkad no, ‘Undini ka,’ na od undini en sikandin. Woy otid ikohiyan ku iddos koddin uripon no, ‘Puungiyu ini,’ na od puungan din en.”

To norinog idda ni Disas, nosoobbuwan sikandin woy id isau riyot mgo minuvu no id tintinundug kandin, kahi rin to, “Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no waa poron nokita ku no minuvu no dakkoo kos kodsalig iling ka‑ay, ahad dini to Israel.”
Na, to id uli ron iddos id popiyod taddot kopitan, nokita ran no no‑uliyan don iddos sudsuhuwon.
Id Badnow ni Disas iddos Anak to Bau
Waa nouhoy pomon tadda, mid undiyon si Disas to bonuwa no id ngoranan to Nain. Id duma mandad kandin iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy dos oray'n mo‑uraan minuvu.

To morani ron sikandan diyot sobbangan to bonuwa, nokosuggung dan to mgo minuvu nid sayung to minatoy amoy id lobbong. Dos id patoy, budtung no anak to ba‑ay'n bau. Mo‑uraa kos mgo minuvu no id duma taddot bau amoy'd loobbong.
To nokita ni Disas iddos bau, no‑eruwan sikandin woy id ikohiyan din to, “Yo kad od sinoggow.”
Na, id porani si Disas woy id somaddan din iddos id soyungan taddot minatoy, de‑en id soro iddos id ponsayung. Kahin Disas to, “Oto, onnow kad.”
Idda ron en, id livod kos songnga taddot konakan, woy id onnow sikandin woy noko‑ooseng don. Nopongnga, id ikohiyan ni Disas dos inoy to, “No‑uyag don kos anak du, ini rad sikandin.”

To nokita idda taddot mgo minuvu, oraroy ran no nosoobbuwan woy id doong dan kos Monama. Kahi ran to, “Id po‑undini to Monama ka‑ay't keta inis motuus no propeta, su amoy od tavang keta no mgo minuvu rin!”
Na iddos dinoggan moka‑atag taddot id puungan ni Disas, nokoso‑ob diyot langun no lugaa no sakup to Judea woy riyot morani no mgo bonuwa.
Id Suhu ni Juan no Tohodboutismu iddos mgo Tinodduwan Din nod Undiyon to ki Disas
Na iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Juan no Tohodboutismu, id undiyon to prisuwan amoy od ponudtuu kandin moka‑atag taddot langun no pinuungan ni Disas.
To norinog idda ni Juan, id po‑undiyon din to ki Disas iddos oruwon tinodduwan din amoy od intud ko sikandin don be‑en kos Mesiyas o od angat pa to ossa?
To id inguma ron sikandan diyot ki Disas, mid intud dan kandin, kahi ran to, “Id po‑undini koy ni Juan no Tohodboutismu amoy od intud ko sikkow ron be‑en kos Mesiyas o od angat koy pa to ossa?”
Na daom to iddon allow, id bowiyan ni Disas dos mo‑uraan od kovohokan. Id poleggua rin iddos mgo busow no id lasud to mgo minuvu woy id bowiyan din iddos mgo butud.

Id osengan ni Disas iddos id suhu ni Juan, kahi rin to, “Livod kow riyot ki Juan, woy ponudtuu row kandin iddos langun no nokita woy norinog dow. Oyya su iddos mgo butud nokokita ron, dos mgo pungku od poko‑ipanow ron, iddos duwon bohok no et‑et no‑uliyan don, dos diid dinog nokorinog don woy dos id poomatoy nongovadnow woy noponudtulan don mandad to Moppiyon Dinoggan iddos mgo worowora.
Ponudtuu row mandad kandin no moppiya kod kotomanan taddot minuvu no waa kodduworuwa koddi.”
Dos Osengan ni Disas Moka‑atag ki Juan no Tohodboutismu

Na, to id ipanow ron iddos mgo minuvu no id suhu ni Juan, mid ooseng si Disas moka‑atag ki Juan diyon to mo‑uraan minuvu. Kahi rin to, “To kod‑undiyon dow to ki Juan to riyon pa sikandin to noka‑awoy‑awoy'n lugaa, ondan man kos id imman dow nod kokita? Idda vo so minuvu no od kopalinpalin kos poomdom iling to aggi nod kopiyodpiyod to kaamag?
Na, ondan man kos id kopi‑i row nod kokita rutun? Idda vo so minuvu no id oumpak to mahaa? Konna en! Su iddos od oumpak to ungketen, diyon da id oubpa to polasyu.
Ondan kos id kopi‑i row nod kokita rutun? Idda vo so propeta? Oyya en, woy od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no lampas pa sikandin to dumon mgo propeta.
Oyyos sikandin en iddos no‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: ‘Id popiyod ku iddos koddin tohodponudtuu no od unna kikow amoy'd panoy to kod‑inguma ru.’ ”

content: Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no waa poron minuvu no id tobbow ka‑ay to ampow't ingod no lampas pa ki Juan. Piru iddos minuvu no moobbava to langun no no‑iraom to kodharit Monama, lampas pa sikandin ki Juan.”
To norinog idda to langun no minuvu, labbi ron en iddos mgo tohodsukut to buhis, id tanggap dan no ollog en iddos puhawang to Monama, oyyos id poboutismu ron man sikandan ki Juan.
Piru iddos mgo Pariseo woy mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises, waa ran id poboutismu ki Juan, su id elleyan dan man iddos puhawang to Monama atag kandan.
Na mid ikahi mandon si Disas to, “Ondan man kos od koponunggelengan ku to mgo minuvu to inin timpu?

Noko‑iling sikandan to mgo anak nod ponggaaw riyot plasa, woy id po‑ikohiyoy ran diyot mgo duma ran to, ‘Id totogunggu koy atag koniyu, piru waa kow man sayow. Id pondaawit koy, piru waa kow man id sinoggow.’

Dos mgo minuvu to inin timpu, od poko‑iling en mandad taddon mgo anak, oyyos si Juan no Tohodboutismu no inaayun od puasa woy waa id inom tod pokohubug, od ikohiyon dow moho no id losuran sikandin to busow.

Woy siyak no Anak to Minuvu, diyot kod‑undini ku, nokita row no id ka‑an woy id inom a. De‑en od ikohiyon dow moho no sopeton a woy polohubug, woy oukuy a kun to mgo tohodsukut to buhis woy dumon mosaasaa.
Piru ahad ungketen, od kosorollan no ollog iddos nonaw ku woy dos nonaw ni Juan, oyyos od koposivonnalan idda riyon to ko‑ontayan taddot mgo minuvu no id pomakoy.”
Id Doddasan si Disas to Pomammut
Duwon sokkad no Pariseo no id ngoranan ki Simon no mid inggat ki Disas nod ka‑an diyot baoy rin. De‑en id undiyon sikandin.

Na rutun no bonuwa, duwon sokkad no ba‑ay'n mosaasaa. To nosorollan din no riyon si Disas to baoy taddot Pariseo, mid undiyon sikandin woy id piyod to pomammut no nokota‑aw riyot tootawwan no id bovallan pomot batu nod ngoranan to alabastro.

Id porani sikandin diyot inoyyuhan ni Disas woy mid lingko‑od diyon lomig to pa‑a rin. Id sinoggow sikandin no id lommos din to dayas iddos pa‑a ni Disas. Na, id punasan din idda to bowvuut uu rin woy id oorokkan. Nopongnga, id doddasan din idda to pomammut.

To nokita taddot Pariseo nid inggat ki Disas iddos id puungan taddot ba‑ay, kohingginawa rin to, “Te, otik mooggot no propeta inin minuvu, od kosorollan din nanoy ko ondan ikon ba‑ay, su oray mohon mosaasaa ika.”
Piru nosorollan ni Disas kos diyot poomdom din, de‑en mid ikahi sikandin to, “Simon, duwon od osengon ku kikow.” Mid tavak si Simon to, “Ondan man, Tohodnonaw?”
Kahin Disas to, “Duwon oruwon minuvu no noko‑utang to soopi riyot tohodposamboy. Dos sokkad, id outang to limmon gatus woy dos sokkad, limmompuu.
To nosorollan taddot tohodposamboy no waa en id pokovayad dan tadda, id podwora rin don iddos utang dan. Na, ondoy musing kandan kos duwon lampas pa no ginawa taddot tohodposamboy?”
Mid tavak si Simon to, “Idda ayu so dakkoo kos no‑utang.” Kahin Disas to, “Ollog kos tavak du.”

Na id loingoy si Disas diyot ba‑ay, woy kahi rin ki Simon to, “Ontongngiyu man inis ba‑ay. To kod‑inguma ku ka‑ay't baoy ru, waa a nikkow boggayi to oweg nid unab to pa‑a ku, piru sikandin, id lommos din to dayas kos pa‑a ku woy id punasan din to bowvuut uu rin.
Waa ka id olit‑olit koddi ukit to kod‑arok, piru inis ba‑ay, pomon to kod‑usok ku, waa soroan din to kod‑arok to pa‑a ku.
Waa ru doddasi to lana kos uu ku, piru sikandin, id doddasan din to pomammut kos pa‑a ku.

De‑en od ikohiyan ku sikkow, no ahad dakkoo kos saa ka‑ay'n ba‑ay, id posinsyan don idda to Monama, de‑en dakkoo kos ginawa rin koddi. Piru iddos minuvu no noposinsyan to disok no saa, disok mandad kos ginawa rin.”
Na id ikohiyan ni Disas iddos ba‑ay to, “Id posinsyan don kos mgo saa ru.”
Iddos mgo minuvu no id ka‑an duma ki Disas, kohingginawa ran to, “Te, inin minuvu, dii od pokoposinsya to mgo saa, oyyos Monama ra en kos od pokopuung tadda!”
Piru id osengan mandon ni Disas iddos ba‑ay, kahi rin to, “Notobbus kad pomon to kopomakoy ru. Na, uli kad bo duma to kosunayan.”
